t: Some Jews said to Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him : You had not buried your Prophet when you picke up differenees about him, when Amir al-Mu'minin, replied : We did not differ about him but we differed after him (i.e. about his succession); whereas you had not dried up your feet after coming out of the river (Nile) when you began asking your Prophet : Make you for us a god as they have gods of their own. Said he : "Verily you are a people behaving ignorantly," (Qur 'an, 7:138)
